about_the_game:
A beautiful pack of art from Hidden Cats in Istanbul is available as a Coloring Book with and Coloring Poster. Both are PDF files with printing resolution, but they can also be used to make a nice digital painting on your preferred software.

You can get a nice gift for family, friends, or yourself. Let's relax, stimulate your creativity, and share your paintings.

Meow, and this is a great way to support us!

Contents:

hcistanbul_coloringbook.pdf (A4 page size)

hcistanbul_poster_A0.pdf (A0 page size)

After downloading, get the PDF files in the game directory where it is installed

1 - Go to your library, find the game, and click with the second mouse button.

2 - Click on Properties, Local Files

3 - Click on Browse

This will open the game directory, and you'll see a folder called "DLC_Coloring_Book" or a similar name.
